The port implements EXACTLY the 4-method protocol run_hierarchy_plan expects and bridges three documented FOLD-RECONCILIATION seams WITHOUT editing #36: (SEAM 1 leaf HYDRATION) #36 descend returns BARE leaf refs {record_version_id, candidate_role:evidence} -- the port hydrates each into a full retriever-0.2 evidence hit: source_chunk leaves via the SHIPPED export_chunk_texts (real source span + source-version content_hash + excerpt hash + text -> reconstruct to the real file), typed-record leaves via the imported Catalog `records` table by record_version_id (NO shipped op returns a typed record's BODY by ref -- list_records omits the body -- so the by-ref body read is the recorded seam; a future #36 SHOULD add a get-record/fetch-by-rvid op); the port ACCUMULATES the exact authoritative source bytes per source_path (collected_source_texts) which op_compile merges so resolve_excerpt reproduces every descended excerpt DETERMINISTICALLY off-machine + live (span sha256 == excerpt_hash; provenance HOLDS). (SEAM 2 PRUNE-CERTIFICATE composition) #36 exposes prune_verdict(node,channel,KEY)->'keep'|'prune' (a per-TERM string, not a certificate) -- the port maps #40's SOUND channel name -> #36's channel, tokenizes the query with #36's OWN tokenizer (so keys match the stored Bloom presence_filter EXACTLY), and SOUNDLY composes the no-false-negative certificate: excludes=True iff EVERY query term is DEFINITELY ABSENT (a lexical/entity relevance needs >=1 term present, so all-absent PROVES the subtree cannot match); a STALE synopsis (#36 returns 'keep') or ANY maybe-present term -> keep; only lexical/entity are certifiable from a plain text query (a bounded top-N descriptor is NEVER advertised or used as a certificate). (SEAM 3/4/5) the port synthesizes the prune_channels + selpol ranking fields + synopsis_fresh flag #36's _node_public lacks, assembles policy_info (one pinned tree_version + corpus_snapshot per compile) from hierarchy_status + the catalog corpus_version, and unwraps #36's {nodes|children+leaf_members} dicts to the flat lists run_hierarchy_plan expects; a descend on an out-of-scope node_id fails closed -> [] (no metadata). V2-V5 stay green through the REAL port (nodes NEVER evidence; every navigation-visible object namespace-closure-checked + SANITIZED abort; retrieval_completeness reflects a real unresolved/pruned frontier; deterministic packet_id covers the hierarchy identity); the flat search hits stay as the recall-safe fallback. Multi-namespace hierarchy FUSION (separate roots) is i36 -> a multi-namespace scope FLAT-falls-back (no recall loss); the multi-channel query ROUTER is i36 (the i32 query_class stub + DESCEND_QUERY_CLASSES stand). The entrypoint's -Retriever artifact_search compile now passes catalog_db_path so the production path constructs the port. non_execution:true UNCHANGED. Proven off-machine over a REAL #36 tree by the OWNED gate tests/test_i35_public_port.py (32/32: constructed-port compile, required-leaf reach+hydrate+reconstruct, source_chunk reconstruction to the ingested file, sound-cert prune + bounded-descriptor/stale never prune, foreign descend fails closed, additive/gated flat byte-identity, deterministic id) + the i34 injected-port fold smoke (38/38) + the shipped suite (322/322). 0.6 (i34 Tier-1 BOUNDED-FANOUT HIERARCHY -- shortlist-and-descend + SAFE PRUNING [P0] + retrieval completeness, D-0098; ADDITIVE over context_packet/0.2 -- schema string UNCHANGED; module semver 0.5.0->0.6.0; a zero-node/flat/non-descend/unscoped compile is BYTE-IDENTICAL to 0.5, every i34 field GATED on a plan actually running) turns the A4/A5-RESERVED hierarchy seam into a real CONSUMER-side retrieval PLAN over #36's authorization-bound shortlist/descend ops (MEMORY_CONTRACT A6 H6): (V1) a DETERMINISTIC descend-decision (the i32 query_class stub; the multi-channel router is i35) routes a global_synthesis/precedent_search class to shortlist authorized roots -> descend the frontier (bounded B nodes/level, D depth -> nav cost O(B*D), sub-linear in leaf count) -> collect LEAF candidates -> the EXISTING selpol/budget/packet path; a local/exact class stays flat-top-k; effective_allowed_namespaces (i33 intersection) + hierarchy_version + the pinned corpus_snapshot are passed to shortlist/descend; nodes (candidate_role=navigation) NEVER enter evidence[] -- they route via navigation_refs + the packet-identity stage trace only. (V2) SAFE PRUNING (P0): a branch is pruned ONLY via a deterministic channel-specific NO-FALSE-NEGATIVE certificate from #36 at the pinned snapshot; else the plan expands / flat-falls-back / sets disposition needs_expansion|abstain; a STALE synopsis never supplies a pruning proof; a bounded lexical/entity/centroid descriptor is NEVER a pruning certificate (it only prioritizes). (V3) RETRIEVAL COMPLETENESS (distinct from evidence coverage): a hierarchy MISS is NOT proved ABSENCE -- frontier_exhausted/pruned_branch_count/prune_policy id+version/prune_reasons[]/fallback_used/stale_navigation_encountered/unresolved_branch_count/max_unexpanded_bound; an UNRESOLVED pruned frontier BLOCKS any definitive-absence claim; a navigation/summary_stale node NEVER enters missing_requirements[]. (V4) packet identity += hierarchy_id + the PINNED tree_version + builder/prune/plan policy ids + the retrieval-plan/stage trace (one tree_version per compile; drift aborts, like corpus_version). (V5) navigation-vs-evidence closure: selection cannot cast a navigation candidate into evidence; EVERY navigation-visible object is namespace-closure-checked via the canonical ns_permitted + fail-closed SANITIZED (a cross-namespace navigation/hierarchy object ABORTS with only a namespace_violation_count). #36 (Lane A) is a PARALLEL i34 producer NOT yet shipped, so off-machine #40 tests the PLAN over an injected port + the REAL #37 lib; the real-tree end-to-end recall proves at the orchestrator D-0077 fold. non_execution:true UNCHANGED. 0.5 (i33 NAMESPACE-CLOSURE + SUPERSESSION-HARDENING, D-0096; ADDITIVE over context_packet/0.2 -- schema string UNCHANGED; module semver 0.4.0->0.5.0) hardens the packet/selection half: (U1') namespace CLOSURE (SAFETY-CRITICAL) -- task_input.namespace is a REQUEST not authorization; the compiler computes effective_allowed_namespaces = intersection(REQUEST, control_plane GRANT) via the imported canonical namespace_policy.effective_allowed_namespaces and passes THAT (never the raw request) to selpol + the retriever; an EMPTY intersection FAILS CLOSED (a namespaced compile REQUIRES a control_plane grant -- control_plane is the only authority); the canonical ns_permitted (IMPORTED from #37 namespace_policy.py, never re-implemented) scope-checks EVERY packet-visible object (evidence, working_memory, provenance/derivation refs, and every diagnostic array) and a cross-namespace object ANYWHERE ABORTS SANITIZED via the canonical NamespaceRejectionPolicy (only a namespace_violation_count surfaces; identifying detail -> a privileged security log, never the packet). (U4') candidate-INDEPENDENT supersession -- the per-candidate CATALOG effective_current signal is passed to selpol so a superseded candidate is hard-filtered under current_only even when its successor is ABSENT from the pool; a supersession BRANCH (>=2 live successors) drives packet_disposition=conflicted. (U2') navigation vs evidence -- a candidate_role=navigation node ROUTES (surfaced in navigation_refs) but is NEVER answer-evidence; NAVIGATIONAL staleness (summary_stale) never fails a coverage requirement. (U3') working_memory hardening -- CONTINUITY-authoritative; access is CONJUNCTIVE (task_id AND effective-namespace); items carry the A5 state_version (packet identity covers it); reserved A5 store fields (store is Tier 1, not built). (U5') query_class/temporal_intent SPLIT -- query_class (semantic) and temporal_intent (current_only|historical_as_of|version_specific|any_valid_version) are INDEPENDENT; an explicit user time/version OUTRANKS the class->mode default (imported from #37's VERSIONED classifier map, with composite/unclassified fallback classes); packet identity covers query_class + temporal_intent + the classifier policy id/version + the working-state state_version + the retrieval-plan/stage trace. It IMPORTS (READ-ONLY, OWNED by #37) the canonical selpol_rrf_v1 + namespace_policy.py (ns_permitted + effective_allowed_namespaces + NamespaceRejectionPolicy) + classifier_policy.py (the versioned class->temporal_intent map); #37 authors these in the SAME i33 wave, so OFF-MACHINE #40 PREFERS the canonical modules and falls back to a BYTE-EXACT REPLICA of each (recorded in selection.import_sources; verified identical under both); the NEW selpol behavior proves at the orchestrator D-0077 mixed-namespace fold with #37's shipped selpol. 0.4 (i32 Tier-0 MEMORY-ARCHITECTURE seam repairs, D-0092) plumbed the Tier-0 seams THROUGH the packet + selection (ADDITIVE over context_packet/0.2 -- schema string UNCHANGED; module semver 0.3.0->0.4.0): (U1) namespace is a HARD boundary BOTH ways -- task_input.namespace -> filters.namespace (retriever) AND params.allowed_namespaces (selpol); a packet NEVER carries a cross-namespace evidence item (a cross-namespace item reaching selection output FAILS CLOSED -- compile abort namespace_leak; refs are namespace-guarded); multi-namespace requires an explicit control_plane grant. (U5) a DETERMINISTIC query-classification STAGE (a stub; the router is Tier 1) maps task_type + descriptor -> query_class (one of the MEMORY_ARCHITECTURE s5 nine: exact_reference|current_state|historical_reconstruction|temporal_change|local_factual|global_synthesis|causal_diagnosis|procedure_selection|precedent_search), stamped into task_input + the selection descriptor + packet identity, and it DRIVES the temporal mode. (U4) current_only derives from query_class (an explicit time_horizon overrides) + is passed to selpol + the retriever query temporal_mode; a current-vs-current contradicts edge among selected evidence drives packet_disposition=conflicted. (U3) the FOURTH top-level packet region working_memory is RESERVED (present-but-empty; store is Tier 1): render order control_plane -> task_input -> working_memory -> evidence; items carry content_role=working_state, can_instruct=false -- task-authoritative for STATE, NOT execution authority and NOT evidence. It imports #37's canonical selpol_rrf_v1 passing the new i32 params (allowed_namespaces/current_only/query_class) and carrying its additive i32 reason_codes (hard_filter_namespace/hard_filter_stale/superseded_demote) onto evidence; the new selpol BEHAVIOR proves at the orchestrator fold with #37's shipped 1.1.0 (off-machine the shipped 1.0.0 ignores the additive params and #40's own namespace fail-closed backstop is proven). 0.3 (i31 SELECTION-POLICY SETTLE) realized P1-1 'one selection owner': it RETIRES the in-module selpol_reference.py stub and IMPORTS #37's ONE CANONICAL selpol_rrf_v1 (modules/37-retrieval-eval/lib/) by a resolved portable path -- the packet schema stays context_packet/0.2; only the selection SOURCE changes. A DETERMINISTIC, CPU-only, stdlib-only Python worker (context_compiler.py) behind a thin PowerShell entrypoint that turns a task descriptor into a versioned, token-budgeted, SAFE, self-describing lifeorch.context_packet/0.2 artifact the coordinator hands a disposable model. It: normalizes the task into a deterministic query set (8.1); retrieves a broad candidate set across record_kinds via a DEFINED retriever seam (8.2); selects/orders candidates by calling #37's canonical selpol_rrf_v1 through the frozen select(candidates, descriptor, policy_id, params) interface (P1-1 / D-0089 -- IMPORTED, not reimplemented; policy_version 1.0.0; raw-fused-score-primary composite + AUTHORITY_RANK/freshness ranks + greedy source-MMR + occurrence-preserving display dedup), supplying params.hard_filter from control_plane.permission_grants (+ descriptor forbidden/privacy), NEVER from an evidence field, with ADDITIVE selection fields that PRESERVE the retrieval order (retrieval/lexical/vector/fused_rank + selection_rank/score/policy_id/selected/reason_codes/rrf_score; the i29 self-contained composite score and the i30 reference stub are RETIRED); fills a configurable token budget with EXACT per-section + total accounting using a fixed HEURISTIC UPPER-BOUND token-count function (ceil(chars/4), NO tokenizer, NO model). The packet has THREE top-level regions with different trust origins (P0-1 SAFETY-CRITICAL): control_plane (policy/permission_grants/request_authority/side_effect_policy/completion_contract/escalation_conditions -- populated ONLY from the descriptor's coordinator/authority fields in a code path that CANNOT read retrieved records, so imperative text in a retrieved README/log can NEVER create a permission grant, set the side-effect policy, or define the completion contract), task_input (original_goal verbatim + normalized_task + constraints + requested_side_effects, which are REQUESTS not authorization), and evidence (every excerpt + ref carries content_role=evidence, can_instruct=false, trust_domain, epistemic_authority, and A2 provenance). It emits a top-level non_execution:true flag and a rendering contract (control_plane first, task_input, then evidence LAST inside hard delimiters as quoted data). It carries a mandatory packet_disposition (answerable|needs_expansion|abstain|conflicted|provenance_failed, P0-3) derived from evidence_requirements/coverage_results/missing_requirements/contradictions -- a normal answer is permitted ONLY when answerable, conservative while the vector channel is empty. It carries a mandatory consumer_profile (model/tokenizer/chat-template/max_context/reserved_* -- P0-4), counts on the FINAL RENDERED input with count_method=conservative_upper_bound + count_is_exact=false, and FAILS CLOSED on transport (oversize evidence drops to the omission_manifest, never truncating control_plane/completion_contract/a required citation). Each excerpt carries A2 provenance (record_content_hash/source_content_hash/excerpt_hash + a provenance_mode in direct_span|derived_record|aggregate|tombstone with per-mode validation; reading a direct_span reproduces the cited bytes -- P0-2). Packet identity/lineage (P1-5): distinct task_id/packet_id(cpkt_+content hash)/parent_packet_id/expansion_id; ONE corpus_version per compile (ABORT on drift); the 0.1 omitted_context is RENAMED omission_manifest. Skill activation cards are recognised as record_kind=summary + attrs.summary_type=skill_activation_card (A3) in addition to structural #38 skill records. A deterministic adaptive-expansion seam `expand` (8.5) returns an IMMUTABLE lifeorch.context_expansion/0.2 delta with the corpus snapshot LOCKED to the parent + a depth bound (NOT a live agent loop). Packet-evaluation hooks (8.6) record per-stage retrieval/post-filter/packet, packet_disposition correctness, and a P0-1 read-only injection probe, so retrieval.eval #37 0.2 can score coverage / provenance validity / packet tokens / disposition. CONSUMER of the FROZEN MEMORY_CONTRACT retriever-0.2 hit shape (s3) + s5 staleness enum + s1/A2 provenance envelope, and of #37's CANONICAL selpol_rrf_v1 (imported by a resolved portable path); PRODUCER of packets consumed by #37 eval + a fresh 9B at the orchestrator fold (D-0077). The RETRIEVER is INJECTED, never called from the deterministic worker: off-machine the entrypoint injects deterministic mock 0.2 hits from a fixture; -Live it runs the real artifact.search #36 `search` op. Non-goals (NOT built): ANY change to #37's selpol_rrf_v1 or its eval (imported READ-ONLY); pure-rank-RRF-as-PRIMARY (the deferred P1-2); real embeddings / vector search (the vector channel may be null); the retriever/catalog DB (#36); skill-CARD content (#41); the eval harness/metrics (#37); the 9B / ANY model; episode recording (#39); skill routing / plan validation; the FULL P0-1 adversarial injection SUITE + the action-capable gate release (a later wave); UI. Deterministic -> determinism=deterministic, confidence=null, empty model_provenance; the context_packet.json artifact is byte-identical on re-run (canonical JSON + a content-derived packet_id).

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -Op compile|normalize|expand (default compile); -Retriever mock|artifact_search (default mock); -CaseFile <path> (mock: a JSON case {task, retrieval_batches, source_texts, retrieval_meta, config?, consumer_profile?}); -Task <path|json> (the task descriptor for normalize / real-retriever compile); -DbPath <#36 catalog> + -RepoRoot <repo root> (-Live: the real retriever seam + span-text resolution); -K <int, default 20> (per-query candidate K); -Request <path|json> + -PacketFile <path> (expand); -ArtifactSearchEntry <path to #36 Invoke-ArtifactSearch.ps1> (default ..\36-artifact-search\Invoke-ArtifactSearch.ps1); -PythonPath <python>; -PwshPath <pwsh for launching #36>; -WorkerPath <context_compiler.py>. OR the generic -InputsJson '<json case>' (same shape as a CaseFile). Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: retriever
inputs.description: mock (deterministic fixture 0.2 hits, off-machine) | artifact_search (the real #36 search op, -Live).

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: the task descriptor {original_goal (IMMUTABLE, preserved verbatim), request_text, namespace/project_id?, task_type?, query_class? (i32/U5: an explicit override of the deterministic task_type->class map), time_horizon? (an explicit value overrides the query_class-derived current_only, i32/U4), authority?, requested_side_effects?, relevant_paths?, relevant_entities?, constraints?, open_questions?, completion_contract?, success_criteria?, escalation_conditions?, control_plane?{policy, permission_grants[], request_authority, side_effect_policy, completion_contract, escalation_conditions[]}, permission_grants?, side_effect_policy?, policy?, evidence_requirements?[{id,type:path|literal|record|any_evidence,value}], contradictions?, consumer_profile?{model_id,tokenizer_id,tokenizer_fingerprint,chat_template_id,max_context,reserved_system_tokens,reserved_tool_tokens,reserved_generation_tokens}, config?}. control_plane is built ONLY from these descriptor fields, NEVER from retrieval (P0-1).

inputs.name: retrieval_batches
inputs.description: mock: per-query batches [{query_index, query, hits:[<retriever-0.2 hit>...]}]. The injected candidate pool.

inputs.name: candidates
inputs.description: mock: a flat list of retriever-0.2 hits (treated as query_index 0) -- alternative to retrieval_batches.

inputs.name: source_texts
inputs.description: mock: {source_path: full_text} used to resolve + reproduce excerpt spans off-machine.

inputs.name: repo_root
inputs.description: -Live: resolve repo-relative source_path -> disk to read + reproduce the cited byte span.

inputs.name: catalog_db_path
inputs.description: i35 (D-0100): the #36 artifact.search catalog db path. When set AND retrieval_meta.retriever selects artifact_search AND the resolved query_class is a DESCEND class AND the compile is scoped, #40 CONSTRUCTS the real ArtifactSearchHierarchyPort over #36's shipped shortlist/descend/prune_verdict ops and runs run_hierarchy_plan for real (no injected hierarchy_port needed). Ignored (flat-top-k, byte-identical to 0.6) for a non-descend / unscoped / non-artifact_search / multi-namespace request, or when #36 / a current hierarchy is unavailable. Also accepted under retrieval_meta.catalog_db_path or as `db`.

inputs.name: hierarchy_port
inputs.description: i34/D-0077 fold seam: an INJECTED live port object implementing policy_info/shortlist/descend/prune_certificate. When present it WINS over the constructed port (used by the orchestrator cross-module fold smoke). Production leaves it unset and supplies catalog_db_path instead.

inputs.name: retrieval_meta
inputs.description: provenance carried into the packet {retriever, retriever_version, corpus_version, index_snapshot, embedding_space_id, fusion_algo, fusion_version}. One corpus_version is pinned per compile; a drift across hits ABORTS (P1-5).

inputs.name: consumer_profile
inputs.description: P0-4 override of the default 9B consumer profile {model_id, tokenizer_id, tokenizer_fingerprint, chat_template_id, max_context, reserved_system_tokens, reserved_tool_tokens, reserved_generation_tokens}. The token count is computed on the FINAL RENDERED input against this profile; a real tokenizer is a later wave (count_is_exact=false today).

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: overrides {token_budget, per_source_cap, max_excerpts, per_excerpt_overhead_tokens, primary_terms_cap, salient_terms_cap, literals_cap, paths_cap, max_queries, candidate_k, expand_max_tokens, expand_max_depth, ref_cap}.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: expand: {type: raw_source|more_evidence|related_symbol|failure_record|tool_contract|prior_episode, target:{record_version_id|record_id|source_path+span}, budget:{max_tokens}, depth?, depth_bound?, namespace?, sensitivity_ceiling?}.

inputs.name: packet
inputs.description: expand: the compiled context packet (or -PacketFile) providing excerpt provenance + the parent corpus snapshot (the expansion delta is LOCKED to it).

inputs.name: expansion_candidates
inputs.description: expand: an injected pool of retriever-0.2 hits to expand from (real #36 or fixture); a candidate from a different corpus_version is refused (P1-5).
